newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: ARCON SHRHOLDERS AGREE OIL DIVISION DEMERGER.
newsitem.headline: ARCON SHRHOLDERS AGREE OIL DIVISION DEMERGER.

text.p: Shareholders in ARCON International Plc on Tuesday approved two resolutions enabling the demerger of ARCON's oil and gas interests to Providence Resources Plc.
ARCON proposes that Providence will be listed on the Exploration Securities Market (ESM) of the Dublin Stock Exchange in the first week of September, subject to High Court approval.
ARCON shareholders on the register as of August 22, 1997 will receive one new share in Providence for every ARCON share held.
Earlier, ARCON said NatWest Markets had underwritten a new $85 million facility for the group.
